Ivy L: Quick PSA: I'm decluttering my desk and offering a white Herman Miller Aeron size B chair (good condition, slight fabric wear on left arm) and a 34\" ultrawide (3440x1440) curved monitor. Free, pick up SF office. I can disassemble the monitor mount if needed.

Markus: Interested in the chair if it's still available. Can pick up Friday morning.

Ivy L: @Markus sure. Can you bring a box cutter and some towels? Chair base is a bit greasy.

Kenji: Wow the ultrawide? Any stand VESA compatible?

Ivy L: @Kenji yes VESA 100mm, stand included. PM me for pics.

Alex - Facilities: If you leave the monitor in storage C, I can help move it to the stairwell on Friday and put it by the gate.

Markus: Confirmed. Chair -> @Markus. I'll meet 9am and bring towels.

Kenji: I'll take the ultrawide. Will coordinate pickup with @Alex - Facilities.

remind-bot: Reminder set "Ivy: leave chair for Markus" 2026-06-02 09:00.

Ivy L: Done. Chair reserved for Markus, ultrawide to Kenji. Thanks everyone!
